title: Comparison

align.recovered: The comparison finished aligning on the server.

empty.title: No quotations yet

needAlign.title: Ready to align

remove.noPermission: Your role does not allow removing columns

aiError.ai_timeout: The read took longer than expected. Retry; if it persists, let us know.
aiError.ai_unavailable: The AI provider is unavailable. Retry in a moment.
aiError.ai_parse: The AI answered something we could not interpret. Retry.
